_options._note: ASHWAX seller-first options desk (credit spreads / iron condors on NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/FINNIFTY). Entry is decided entirely by _seller_desk_loop / SellerDesk.run_cycle() in src/orchestrator.py / src/options/seller_desk.py -- regime + IVR + term-structure classification drives strategy_selector.candidates(), NOT the entry_conditions below, which are deliberately impossible (RSI can never exceed 100) so this spec is inert if ever evaluated through the normal per-bar USS scan. It exists only so this strategy is listed/toggleable in strategies_registry.json like every other strategy, per this project's registry-visibility convention. Real risk gating now flows through src/risk/crm.py's G0-G10 pipeline via src/options/seller_crm_adapter.build_seller_crm_signal() (see strategies_registry.json's entry for this strategy for the live on/off switch, which is NOT this file's enabled flag). direction MUST stay 'LONG', not 'BOTH': the compiler mirrors entry_conditions for the SHORT leg (value_above -> value_below), so 'RSI > 1000' -- impossible on the LONG side -- becomes 'RSI < 1000' on the SHORT side, which is ALWAYS true (RSI is bounded 0-100). With 'BOTH' this fired thousands of bogus equity SHORT signals under this strategy's name every scan cycle (found 2026-09-04, only saved from reaching real orders by intraday_regime happening to read BULL that day, which blocks all SHORT entries) -- do not change back without fixing the mirroring issue first.
